scope: 1440x1000 desktop Chrome; isolated synthetic 300/1000 chapters, 1500 characters each
limitations: Synthetic local baseline; no literary quality or competitive ranking claim.
No CPU/network throttling; SQLite and filesystem caches are warm after seeding.
Other release verification may run concurrently on the same machine.
Input.insertText commits Chinese characters directly; this does not measure an IME.
Input-to-frame is a requestAnimationFrame estimate, not physical display latency.
